answer_1.quote: We propose a Track‑SQL framework, aimed at solving the problems of dynamic schema linking and context information filtering in multi‑turn Text‑to‑SQL dialogues... the SQL generation phase ... fine‑tune the text‑to‑SQL generation model ... with the target output being normalized SQL queries.

answer_2.quote: We adopted two official metrics: Question Match (QM) and Interaction Match (IM), along with three widely recognized sub‑metrics: Exact Match Accuracy (EM), Execution Accuracy (EX), and Test Suite Accuracy (TS)... we introduced a set of strict evaluation metrics: Table Redundancy Score (TRS@​s) and Column Redundancy Score (CRS@​s).
